blog.title: SEO Best Practices for Modern Websites
blog.description: Boost your website's search engine rankings with these proven SEO strategies and techniques that work in 2024.
blog.author: CodMonks Team
blog.content:
# Core Web Vitals
            Improve LCP, FID, and CLS scores for better rankings.

            # Structured Data
            Implement schema.org to enhance snippets.

            # Mobile-First
            Ensure full responsiveness and usability on all devices.

            # Content
            Use targeted keywords, rich media, and regular updates.
